name: server/mzizi-data
title: mzizi-data
summary: What every Mzizi database client shares: the transport trait, the error type and (on a Worker) the TLS socket. Nothing database-specific. The server harness is the separate mzizi-harness crate.

surface.summary: The byte transport: write_all and read_exact. A protocol core is generic over it and never opens a socket.
Uri, Io, Timeout, Codec, Protocol, Auth, Server, Refused.

harness.secrets: mzizi-data emits no events. It holds no state a harness could see.

gaps: The Postgres and SQLite clients (mzizi-postgres, mzizi-sqlite) do not exist yet; nothing is stubbed.
workers::SocketIo is compiled only for wasm32 with the workers feature, so its contract is held by a type check and clippy for wasm32-unknown-unknown, not by a native test.
